pages.text: $(thing)Algorithms$()$(br2)A recipe precise enough for a machine. Some take steps in proportion to the input, some its square: sorting a million things can take twenty million steps, or a trillion.

$(thing)Insight$(): 80$(br2)$(thing)Builds on$(): Vectors and Matrices, Combinatorics.$(br2)$(thing)Samples$(): 16 Natural Number Lattice.$(br2)$(thing)Derivation$(): A good sort of n things compares them about n·log₂ n times. Write that count M.
